title: Seller Material Fact Disclosure (Johnson v. Davis)
description: Florida common law requires sellers to disclose all known material defects not readily observable. No mandated state form — accomplished via FAR/BAR contract or written disclosure.

required_actions.note: Typically included in FAR/BAR contract or separate seller disclosure letter.

title: HOA/Condominium Disclosure
description: Florida Statute §720.401 requires sellers to provide a disclosure summary of HOA governing documents. For condos, §718.503 requires disclosure of condo documents. Buyer has 3 business days to void.

required_actions.note: Buyer has 3 business days to void after receipt of condo docs or HOA disclosure.

title: Radon Disclosure
description: Florida Statute §404.056(5) requires every sale/lease contract to include the radon gas disclosure statement (verbatim statutory text).

required_actions.note: Required radon disclosure language must appear in the contract verbatim per §404.056(5).

title: Energy Efficiency Rating Disclosure
description: Florida requires sellers to notify buyers that an energy efficiency rating may be obtained.

required_actions.note: Include in the contract or as a separate addendum.
